header: I draw the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and inflation of MoSPI as column charts: the index of each month of all India in three tabs (Combined, Urban, Rural), the same for any State (the plant's own, West Bengal, first), and the year-on-year inflation rate of the last 1, 3, 5 or 10 years in four tabs. The figures are MoSPI's own, saved in the database (src/lib/live/cpi.ts says what they are and how they were checked); a month MoSPI has not published is not drawn, and I estimate nothing. This is the CPI of the people at large, not the CPI-IW that the dearness allowance follows: the card says so. A bar chart tells the truth only from a starting line it names, so the inflation chart starts at zero (a rate below zero hangs under it) and the index chart starts at 100, the base year's own level (2024 = 100), and says so.

behaviours: the sector tabs are a real tab list with the three sectors, Combined chosen
it opens on the plant's own State, West Bengal, with a bar for each of the ten months and the value on each bar
the chart says where its bars start (100, the base year) and that the base year is 2024 = 100
the latest month, the rise since January and when the next is due are given
All India is first in the State list, and the list is the State dropdown of the tools
All India, Rural: 110.73 for October (MoSPI's own figure), Jan 104.59
an unknown State falls back to all India (never an empty chart)
the years are four tabs: 1Y 3Y 5Y 10Y, 1Y chosen
1 year: 13 bars, Oct 2025 to Oct 2026, with the rates on the bars (0.25 ... 6.09) as on Trading Economics
the facts: latest 6.09% (Oct 2026), highest 6.09, lowest 0.25 (Oct 2025)
under the chart, the alarm: inflation above the RBI's limit, 6.09% from 5.54%, first time since Oct 2024; it is under the chart and above the note, and the same in every window
a rate within the band is a calm green note, not an alarm
it says what the rate is and which two series it joins
10 years: 119 bars drawn of 121 months (two blank), no values on the bars, the gap named
10 years: the highest and lowest of the ten (7.79 in Apr 2022? read from the data, not typed)
3 and 5 years: 37 and 61 months

one colour (the original tan) in three depths: Combined darkest, Urban the original tan, Rural lightest (same warm hue), the same in an all-India chart and a State chart, and each sector tab carries its shade
the inflation chart starts at zero, and a rate below zero hangs under it in red
scales: a rate from zero; an index from 100; round values; room for the labels
under-axis texts are never closer than the gap: 10 years keep the years only, 1 year every month
the hover of an index bar names the month, the index and the rate; a missing month says so
the card says what the CPI is and that it is not the CPI-IW of the dearness allowance, and when the next is due
the card has two tabs, the dearness allowance (the first, as before) and CPI and inflation
